proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the map sends the triple (T, g, L) of the Picard stack to the same triple viewed in the coherent stack situation, which makes sense because L is finitely presented, flat over T (base change of flatness) and has proper support (base change of properness); the content is: for an object (T, g, F) of the coherent stack there is an open U in T such that (a) factoring through U is equivalent to (b) F_{T'} being invertible; take W the open locus where F is finite locally free (commuting with base change), replace T by T minus the image of the complement of W, where F is finite locally free, and use the disjoint union decomposition into rank-i loci to define U as the complement of the image of the loci of rank other than 1 (open because quasi-compact T gives finitely many nonempty pieces) (source lines 2828-2874)
